title: Grateful Pets
description: Feed and care for your pets and they will thank you. Chat with a real pet to feed it (food, taste/tiredness, treasure + 1 now/4-over-time desalination pellets produced locally and shared) or care for it (tonics/syringes applied to the pet for a healing treasure). Robotic pets get robot-flavored reactions, a 20% bonus energy-cell roll on feed/care, and robot care: give a spent energy cell and it runs a software update to return a fresh cell (biological tonics often fail on robots). Corpse-milestone rewards, pellet-to-container use. Works on saves in progress.
author: Christopher Mayfield
